summary: User redesign of the MPI-362 composite after using it: instead of a blind Add/Subtract modal gated on one entry already carrying a mask, selecting two entries should overlay the first over the second on the canvas and give a brush/eraser pair - the eraser removes the top image to reveal the one under it, the brush paints it back. Delivered as a NEW composite tool in the rail (user's own preference over force-selecting a mask tool), sibling of the MPI-371 mask family. Proposed shape: the erase layer IS a mask, so Apply reuses the existing full-res /project/composite-media route untouched and the only new code is the live two-image preview.

maturity idea -> planned. the redesign is fully specified and the server route it reuses already ships. Board-wide re-stamp against the grown 10-value enum (todo gained research / needs-decision / blocked / deferred on 2026-07-31); every todo card had been sitting on idea or planned because those were the only values that existed when it was written.

Re-scoped by the MPI-424 brainstorm into a COMPOSITE GROUP of two buttons. Mask Comp takes 1 image slot + 1 mask slot; Paint Comp takes 1 image slot. The SELECTED ENTRY is image 1 and sits on top, the slot holds image 2 underneath, and the two comps are one operation with two front ends - Paint Comp paints the cut live, Mask Comp takes it from the mask slot. Slots are filled by PASTE (a new Copy in the context menu beside the existing Copy mask), which retires the select-two-entries modal. User's reason, verbatim in spirit: the shipped composite gets run three or four times because the blend is invisible while deciding and changing the selection restarts it.

Plan attached: tasks/MPI-373/plan.md. Three forks the card left open were resolved with the user first, so implementation carries no unresolved decisions. (1) The composite hole gets its OWN scratch layer, a CompositeManager compCanvas beside manual/subtract/paint - reusing the mask layers was rejected because the mask persists per entry, so a composite would silently consume and leave behind a mask brushed for an inpaint. (2) Size mismatch is COVER, centred, so a revealed pixel is always filled. (3) MpiMaskCompositeDialog and the select-two-entries path are DELETED, not kept as a fast path. The server route and _runComposite stay untouched, and fillHoles stays opt-out per MPI-437. Verify mode user-ux.
Implementation started on the approved plan (tasks/MPI-373/plan.md). Last card of the MPI-424 umbrella: the Composite group, one operation with two front ends, replacing the blind MPI-362 modal.

Composite SHIPPED and user-tested. Paint Comp works. Two bugs fixed and guarded: Apply silently no-oped after the first press (loadImage wiped the cut without announcing, so the gate went stale), and both media slots rendered thumbnail AND empty state at once (a class carrying display outranks [hidden] - the MPI-382 trap). Suite 386/0, 7 negative controls. Handing off the REDESIGN the user then specified: right-click canvas -> Send to Composite fills the image slot for both front ends and Copy image leaves the history menu; the mask slot is DELETED in favour of the selected entry own mask. Handoff c1a7f4e2-9b30-4d68-8f51-2e6a0d7c3b95.

Session closed with the card in doing. Composite committed as 9db6635e; Paint Comp verified by the user in the app. Apply stays disabled with both slots filled - open bug, distinct from the stale-gate defect fixed in that commit. Redesign specified and carried in handoff c1a7f4e2-9b30-4d68-8f51-2e6a0d7c3b95. Validator delta 0 (416 resting, both before and after).
Composite group shipped and user-tested in the app; redesign, the dead-cut-on-entry-switch fix and the 4px right-edge regression all closed.
